tools.name: tdd_meta
tools.description: API version, counts, doctrine URL, MCP endpoints.

tools.name: tdd_search
tools.description: Search schools, universities, apps, podcasts, exams, tutors. Filters: type, city, goal, cefr, online, verified_pro, platform, kind.

tools.name: tdd_shortlist
tools.description: Top fit shortlist. Enforces non-compete: DFL items come with non-DFL alternatives.

tools.name: tdd_tutors
tools.description: Tutor market index. Defaults toward Verified Pros (3k+ lessons, 4.9+).

tools.name: tdd_compare
tools.description: Compare two provider or tutor slugs with a plain-language verdict.

tools.name: tdd_path
tools.description: Outward-pointing study path (resources + trials). Not a progress tracker. Practice may deep-link to Dutch Fluency with alternatives.

tools.name: tdd_stats
tools.description: Live counts, Pro rates, median prices, type breakdown.

tools.name: tdd_graph
tools.description: Dutch Learning Graph snapshot. slim=true returns counts and types only.

tools.name: tdd_move_plan
tools.description: Work backward from an arrival or exam date.

tools.name: tdd_employer_budget
tools.description: HR planning ranges (not a quote) for Dutch training headcount.

tools.name: tdd_city_gaps
tools.description: What provider types a city lacks in the independent index.

tools.name: tdd_death_watch
tools.description: Stub names, missing prices/lessons — scrape health, not legal claims.

tools.name: tdd_conflict_ledger
tools.description: Public policy for when Dutch Fluency products appear in shortlists.

tools.name: tdd_evidence_pack
tools.description: Shareable independent study plan artifact for employers/paperwork. Not legal advice.
